recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, expressionist oil-painted profile of a man rendered in deep blues and vibrant greens, featuring heavy impasto textures and visible palette knife strokes. The composition is anchored by a large, right-aligned typographic block using a mix of sans-serif and serif fonts in white and orange.
coreVisualRelationships: The profile silhouette emerges from a textured green vertical band on the left into a deep blue field.
The primary text block overlaps the right side of the painted face, creating a tension between figure and ground.
The orange accent text provides a warm counterpoint to the cool-toned blue and green background.
coreInvariants: Heavy impasto texture with visible ridges and grooves.
A palette restricted to ultramarine blue, emerald green, and a highlight of bright orange.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large-scale profile face occupies the left two-thirds of the frame, facing left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large white sans-serif name in the center-right acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the white text, move up to the orange title, then sweep left along the profile's gaze, finally descending the tracklist on the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the entire canvas is filled with dense painterly texture.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Ultramarine and Cobalt Blue (Background and shadows)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Emerald and Forest Green (Left vertical band and highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the blues and greens with high value contrast provided by the white typography.
paletteRestrictions: No warm reds or yellows outside of the specific orange accent.
No flat black; shadows are deep blue.

letterConstructionRules: Tight kerning and leading in the main display text.
Mixed case for the main name, all-caps for technical metadata.
characterSpecificRedesigns: None; relies on standard mid-century grotesque and serif forms.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold sans-serif for the subject name paired with a smaller, high-contrast orange sans-serif for the title and a delicate italic serif for the tracklist.
graphicDevices: Geometric logo box in the top left corner
Stereo banner at the top center

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and mid-century feel of the main name.
Provides the clean, geometric structure for the orange title.
Captures the classic, elegant feel of the tracklist.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create an expressionist oil painting of a man's profile facing left. Use heavy impasto texture with visible palette knife strokes. The left third should be a vertical band of emerald green, transitioning into a deep ultramarine blue field that makes up the rest of the background and the shadows of the face. The face should be stylized and moody.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large block of text on the right side. The main name should be in large, bold white sans-serif, slightly overlapping the painted face. Above it, place the title in bold orange sans-serif, right-aligned. Below the name, add a secondary line in orange. In the bottom right corner, add a list of items in a small, white italicized serif font, right-aligned.

verificationChecks: Is the impasto texture clearly visible?
Is the text right-aligned and overlapping the portrait?
Is the color palette strictly blue, green, white, and orange?

adjustableVariables: Proportion of green vs blue in the background
Scale of the main typographic block
mustRedesign: Any specific corporate logos or trademarks
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the orange text is vibrant and legible against the blue.
Check that the paint texture looks physical rather than a digital filter.
Verify the right-alignment of the typographic block.
Confirm the profile silhouette is distinct but painterly.
recipe.reuseFormula: Expressionist Impasto Portrait + Mid-Century Modernist Typography + Asymmetrical Right-Aligned Layout + Blue/Green/Orange Palette
